simple.summary: פָּסַס (pâçaç) means probably to disperse , i.e. (intransitive) disappear First listed occurrence: Ps 12 2.

definitions.full: H6461. pasas II. [ פָסַס ] verb disappear, vanish (si vera lectio, compare Assyrian pasâsu, do away , blot out (especially sins)); — Qal Perfect 3plural מִן מַּסּוּ Psa 12:2 the faithful have vanished (Che Dr) from (among) . . . men; Lag Proph. Chald. xivi Gr We Du read אָֽפְסוּ ( Isa 16:4 ).
